name: Patient Identity & National Health ID
purpose: Establish one authoritative, consent-aware patient identity per person across the national network, and issue the National Health ID.
invariants: A National Health ID is never reused, never recycled, and never encodes PHI.
Two patient records may only be merged through a reviewed, reversible link with full lineage.
An identifier value is unique per (tenant, issuer, type) and case-normalised on write.
Merge never deletes the source record; it becomes a redirect target.
consistency: Strong inside a patient aggregate; eventual for cross-facility identity propagation.

name: Consent, Privacy & Lawful Access
purpose: Evaluate consent directives, purpose-of-use, and legal basis at every access boundary, and record break-glass use.
invariants: Deny by default; absence of consent is not consent.
Break-glass is time-boxed, reason-coded, notified, and independently reviewed.
A consent withdrawal is effective for new access immediately and never rewrites prior history.
Policy decisions are versioned; every decision cites the policy version used.
consistency: Strong on directives, read-optimised with a short-lived versioned cache.

name: Encounters, Admission & Care Teams
purpose: Model every care contact from arrival to discharge, including transfers, care team membership, and location history.
invariants: An encounter always references a patient and a facility in the same tenant.
Status transitions follow the clinical state machine; completed requires an end time.
Care team changes are append-only history, never destructive edits.
A discharge summary cannot be signed while unresolved critical results are open without an explicit acknowledgement.
consistency: Strong inside the encounter aggregate; eventual for downstream reporting.

name: Clinical Record, Notes & Medical History
purpose: Own the longitudinal clinical record: signed documents, problems, allergies, observations, immunisations, procedures, family and social history.
invariants: A signed document version is immutable; amendments create a new version with a reason.
Every clinical statement carries author, effective time, and provenance.
Allergy and problem entries are never hard-deleted; entered-in-error is an explicit status.
Clinical values are unit-bearing; a numeric value without a UCUM unit is rejected.
consistency: Strong per document version; eventual for derived summaries and search.

name: Orders & Diagnostic Orchestration
purpose: Orchestrate service requests and result lifecycle across laboratory, imaging, procedures, and external providers.
invariants: A result is only final after contributor and verifier identity are recorded.
A corrected result supersedes but never overwrites a finalised result.
Order state changes are idempotent and auditable by request id.
A critical result must have a documented notification before the order is closed.
consistency: Strong per order; eventual for cross-facility visibility.

name: Medication Management & Safety
purpose: Own prescribing, safety checking, administration, and reconciliation with hard human-oversight gates.
invariants: No order reaches dispensing without a recorded safety review outcome.
A hard-stop may only be overridden by an authorised clinician with a reason and, where policy requires, a second reviewer.
Dose is structured (value + UCUM unit + route + frequency); free text alone is invalid.
Administration always references an order and, where required, a dispensed lot.
consistency: Strong per order and administration; eventual for formulary updates.

name: Emergency & Prehospital Care
purpose: Coordinate dispatch, prehospital care, triage, resuscitation, and mass-casualty response where minutes decide outcomes.
invariants: Emergency documentation must be completable with no connectivity and reconciled later.
Triage category changes are timestamped and attributed, never silently overwritten.
An unidentified patient may be treated under a temporary identity that is later linked, never duplicated.
Dispatch state is monotonic and idempotent; duplicate dispatch requests are rejected.
consistency: Strong locally, convergent after reconnection; conflict resolution by clinical review.

name: Telemedicine & Remote Consultation
purpose: Deliver remote consultation, asynchronous messaging, and referral between facilities with the same clinical record guarantees.
invariants: A remote consultation is an encounter with an explicit channel and consent to remote care.
Recordings and transcripts are opt-in, consented, encrypted, and retention-bound.
A referral has an explicit receiving organisation and cannot auto-close without their action.
Prescribing remotely requires the same verification gates as in person.
consistency: Strong session state; eventual media artefacts.

name: Laboratory Operations
purpose: Manage the laboratory workflow from order acceptance through specimen custody, analysis, verification, and release.
invariants: A specimen is unique and traceable for its entire custody chain.
A rejected specimen cannot produce a released result.
A released result requires technical and clinical verification per test policy.
Reference ranges are versioned and resolved at result time, not display time.
consistency: Strong within the laboratory; eventual to the ordering facility.

name: Radiology & Medical Imaging
purpose: Own imaging orders, protocol review, study references in PACS/VNA, and signed radiology reports.
invariants: Pixel data stays in PACS/VNA; the platform stores references, hashes, and reports.
A study reference is unique by Study Instance UID.
A final report is signed and immutable; amendments create a new version.
Laterality and protocol screening are mandatory before acquisition.
consistency: Strong for reports; eventual for study availability events.

name: Pharmacy Dispensing
purpose: Dispense against verified prescriptions with lot traceability, returns, and recall response.
invariants: No dispense without a verified order and an available, in-date, non-quarantined lot.
Every dispense decrements inventory through an append-only ledger entry.
A recall can reach every affected patient and lot within the defined response window.
A dispense reversal is a new record, never an edit.
consistency: Strong within a pharmacy; eventual for national stock views.

name: Inventory & Supply Chain
purpose: Track stock, lots, expiry, quarantine, transfers, and consumption as an append-only ledger across the national network.
invariants: Stock balances are derived from the ledger; there is no mutable balance column.
A movement is signed, attributed, and never updated or deleted.
Expired, quarantined, or recalled stock cannot be issued.
Inter-facility transfers balance to zero across the pair.
consistency: Strong per location; eventual for national aggregate stock.

name: Billing, Claims & Revenue
purpose: Price services, issue invoices, allocate payments, manage claims and adjustments, and maintain a double-entry ledger.
invariants: Money is integer minor units; currency is explicit and never implicit.
An invoice balance equals total minus allocations, enforced in the database.
Over-allocation beyond a payment is impossible.
The ledger is append-only and balanced; corrections are reversals.
consistency: Strong per invoice and payment; eventual across facilities.

name: Scheduling & Capacity
purpose: Manage appointments, resources, unavailability, and capacity signals across facilities.
invariants: Two booked appointments for one resource may never overlap.
Bookings are idempotent by request key and version-checked on update.
Time is stored as an instant plus the source timezone.
A cancelled slot is immediately rebookable.
consistency: Strong per resource; eventual for cross-facility capacity views.

name: Workforce, Credentialing & Privileges
purpose: Own staff identity binding, roles, credentials, licences, privileges, and assignment scope.
invariants: A user cannot hold a clinical privilege without a verified, in-date credential.
Role assignment is scoped by tenant/facility/department and time-bound.
Credential expiry automatically blocks privileged actions at the next access check.
Termination revokes sessions and sync devices immediately.
consistency: Strong; authoritative for authorisation inputs.

name: Organisation & Facility Registry
purpose: Maintain the authoritative registry of organisations, facilities, departments, service capability, and opening status.
invariants: Facility codes are unique per tenant and globally resolvable.
A facility cannot be deactivated while active episodes of care exist without an explicit migration plan.
Service capability changes are versioned and visible to referral and emergency routing.
consistency: Strong; replicated read-only to every cell.

name: Terminology & Value Sets
purpose: Distribute approved code systems, value sets, and versioned mappings so every facility reasons with the same vocabulary.
invariants: No clinical record may cite a code system version that is not registered.
Mapping changes never rewrite stored codes; they apply prospectively and are versioned.
A retired concept remains resolvable for historical records.
consistency: Eventual; versioned releases.

name: Health Information Exchange
purpose: Provide the national record locator, FHIR facade, consent-aware sharing gateway, and external interface adapters.
invariants: No cross-organisation data leaves without a policy decision and an audit record.
Every exchange is attributable to a requesting organisation, user, purpose, and legal basis.
Inbound messages are quarantined until validated and mapped; nothing is written straight into clinical tables.
Document sharing preserves the source's signature and provenance.
consistency: Strong for authorisation; eventual for propagation.

name: Offline Synchronisation & Field Continuity
purpose: Keep care running without connectivity, then converge safely without ever inventing or overwriting clinical facts.
invariants: A device holds only the scope it is entitled to, with an expiry and a visible freshness marker.
No last-write-wins for clinical facts; conflicts require human resolution.
Every mutation carries a device, user, base version, and idempotency key.
Revocation triggers local wipe on next contact and blocks sync immediately.
consistency: Convergent with explicit conflict handling; never silent merges of clinical data.

name: Public Health Surveillance & Reporting
purpose: Turn care data into notifiable-disease signals, coverage indicators, and ministry reporting without exposing individual records.
invariants: Surveillance receives the minimum dataset; identifiers are replaced by linkage tokens.
Small-cell suppression applies to every published aggregate.
A signal never identifies an individual and never auto-triggers enforcement action.
Reporting definitions are versioned and reproducible.
consistency: Eventual; batch and streaming indicators.

name: Clinical AI Governance & Assistance
purpose: Register, approve, run, review, and audit AI assistance with human oversight and fail-closed behaviour.
invariants: No inference runs on an unapproved model version.
AI output is a draft until a named clinician accepts, edits, or rejects it.
Every inference records inputs by reference, prompt version, and model version.
Any AI safety incident is recorded and can trigger immediate model suspension.
consistency: Strong for approvals; eventual for evaluation telemetry.

name: Audit, Security & Access Evidence
purpose: Provide tamper-evident audit, access review, anomaly detection, and independent evidence retention.
invariants: Audit is append-only, tenant-scoped, and independent of the application database.
Audit stores field names and metadata, never full PHI payloads.
Audit survives loss of a clinical cell and is retained per legal schedule.
Every privileged action is attributable to a human or a named service identity.
consistency: Append-only, eventually consistent replication to an independent store.

name: Notifications & Clinical Communication
purpose: Deliver critical-result, appointment, and recall notifications across channels with delivery evidence.
invariants: A critical result notification is retried until acknowledged or escalated to a human.
Delivery is never claimed as success without evidence.
Patient-facing messages contain the minimum necessary information.
consistency: At-least-once with acknowledgement.

name: Documents & Medical Media
purpose: Store, encrypt, scan, version, and serve documents, scans, and media references under least-privilege access.
invariants: Objects are encrypted at rest with tenant-scoped keys and accessed only via short-lived authorised URLs.
Every object is hash-recorded, malware-scanned, and immutable once attached to a signed record.
Deletion is policy-driven and auditable; legal holds override deletion.
consistency: Strong per object; eventual for derived indexes.
